interpretation.summary: MECH-063 sub-claim (ii) tonic-vs-phasic dissociation on the E3 softmax temperature. The TONIC lever (MECH-313 noise_floor) moves the SUSTAINED (quiescent-tick) baseline entropy; the PHASIC lever (SD-069 phasic_surprise_burst, sharp instantaneous_pe source) moves an EVENT-LOCKED entropy TRANSIENT; cross-legs ~0. PASS = both hold (independent tonic-baseline vs phasic-transient degrees of freedom on one readout); FAIL/weakens = they do not dissociate; FAIL/non_contributory = the run could not test the claim -- labelled sample_starvation_requeue when a SAMPLE COUNT was short (substrate present and firing; offending cell named) and substrate_not_ready_requeue only when a substrate CAPABILITY check failed. Supersedes V3-EXQ-779a, whose load-bearing criterion PASSED (mean_dS_tonic +0.265 vs margin 0.05; mean_dR_phasic -0.048 vs margin 0.02; 4 dissociating seeds = min_seeds 4; robust, non-degenerate) but was withheld because phasic_fires_real_events measured 6 vs 10 -- sourced entirely from seed 23 / T1P1, whose 120-EPISODE cap bound before the 2400-STEP cap at ~7 steps per episode. 779b step-denominates that cap so the step cap binds for every cell; no threshold and no aggregation rule changed.

notes: MECH-063 sub-claim (ii) tonic/phasic split behavioural dissociation. SUPERSEDES V3-EXQ-779a (same scientific question; ONE-PARAMETER exposure fix per failure_autopsy_MECH-063-777a-779a-cluster_2026-07-18, REE_assembly origin/master 0a5cd3f24b, targets[1]). 779a's load-bearing criterion double_dissociation_C1_and_C2 ALREADY PASSED -- criteria_non_degenerate true, robust true, diss_seed_count 4 = min_seeds 4, mean_dS_tonic +0.265 (sd 0.072) vs SUSTAINED_MARGIN 0.05, mean_dR_phasic -0.048 (sd 0.037) vs TRANSIENT_MARGIN 0.02 -- and was withheld SOLELY because phasic_fires_real_events measured 6 vs threshold 10, a min-across-cells sourced entirely from seed 23 / T1P1. ROOT CAUSE (capability RULED OUT: burst_level_max 1.00 in every PHASIC-ON cell including both seed-23 cells, and seed 23's firing RATE of 7.2-11.9 event ticks per 1000 env steps sits INSIDE the range other seeds span): seed 23 dies in ~7 steps per episode, so 779a's 120-EPISODE cap bound before its 2400-STEP cap and the cell received only 835 of 2400 available steps. Seed 23's cells are the only ones at/near the episode cap (n_episodes 116/116/120/120 vs 8-52 elsewhere) and its two PHASIC-ON cells the only two of sixteen reporting stop_reason 'episode_cap'. 779a's F1 made the stopping RULE sample-driven but left the CAP episode-denominated, so the V3-EXQ-777/779 starvation defect reappeared one layer down on the same seed. THE FIX: MAX_EPISODES_PER_CELL is now DERIVED from MAX_ENV_STEPS_PER_CELL (equal to it) rather than an independent 120, so the step cap binds for EVERY cell however short its episodes; a module-level assert pins the invariant. This restores the shared helper's own documented default (RolloutBudget sets max_episodes = max_env_steps when not overridden) -- 779a's 120 was an override of already-correct behaviour. Expected: seed 23 / T1P1 goes 835 -> 2400 steps, taking event ticks 6 -> ~17 at its own measured rate, clearing MIN_EVENT_TICKS 10 without touching the threshold. Progress prints are step-denominated to match. DELIBERATELY UNCHANGED (autopsy directs all three be KEPT): min-across-cells readiness aggregation -- it did legitimate work here, since seed 23 IS the criterion's largest contributor (dR_phasic -0.108 on 6 ticks) and excluding it leaves 3 dissociating seeds vs min_seeds 4, so the PASS genuinely depended on the under-exposed cell; the sample-vs-capability precondition kind classification (why 779's mislabelling did not recur); and per-cell stop_reason recording (what made this a one-command diagnosis). No threshold, margin, or aggregation rule is nudged -- only exposure changes. TONIC = MECH-313 noise_floor (sustained temperature lift); PHASIC = SD-069 phasic_surprise_burst with the sharp instantaneous_pe source. Complements V3-EXQ-777/777a (sub-claim i). GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = event ticks and dR_phasic for seed 23 / T1P1 at adequate exposure; checked 779 and 779a (the only runs of this family, substrate_hash 765ce9d248 for 779a) -- 779a records that cell at 835 of 2400 steps with 6 event ticks, i.e. it records the SHORTFALL, not the answer, and no reprocessing can manufacture unobserved ticks -> run. Re-derive brake: claim-level count reaches threshold 2 but this lineage is EXEMPT (targets[1].re_derive_brake.exempt=true) -- it is not circling a substrate ceiling, its load-bearing criterion passed non-degenerately, and the autopsy's recommended_substrate_queue_entry for this target is action 'none'. NOT blocked on SD-PROBE-WARMUP / SD-073, which brakes the 777 lineage only.

evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-779b (MECH-063 sub-claim ii) -- non_contributory, substrate_ceiling. The 779a episode-cap fix verifiably took effect (seed 23 / T1P1: 835 -> 2400 env steps, stop_reason episode_cap -> step_cap, episode_cap_can_bind False) and the precondition did not move: phasic_fires_real_events measured 6 vs threshold 10, the MIN having migrated from T1P1/seed23 (6 -> 13) to T0P1/seed23 (10 -> 6). Root cause is NOT exposure and NOT SD-069 capability (burst_level_max = 1.00 in every PHASIC-ON cell): the phasic regulator resets its surprise-EMA cold at each episode boundary with a ~10-tick time constant, while seed 23's episodes last ~6.9 steps, so its baseline never converges and added steps arrive as more cold restarts. The withholding is CORRECT rather than spurious: diss_seed_count 4 sits at exactly MIN_SEEDS 4 and leave-one-out collapses the verdict for 4 of 5 seeds INCLUDING seed 23, so the load-bearing criterion depends on the very cell the gate flags; seed 23's dR_phasic -0.110 on ~9.5 event ticks is equally well read as small-sample effect-size inflation, and n=5 cannot discriminate. Separately, robust:true used the mean-minus-population-SD idiom retired by MECH-063 autopsy follow-up #4; under the corrected SEM bar the phasic leg fails at k=2 (+0.0179 vs margin 0.02) while the tonic leg passes. Booked as pending_retest_after_substrate against sd_phasic_ema_episode_continuity. MECH-063 remains lit-only (exp_conf 0.0); no demotion -- the probe has not yet let the claim express itself.
